requirement_vague: Verify that a second user cannot read another user's item. Confirm access is denied.
requirement_precise: Register a new user and obtain an access token via the authentication endpoint. Create an item in the system with that user. Register a second user and get its access token. Attempt to read the created item using the access token of the second user. Verify that the response status code is 400 and the response body contains a detail field with the value "Not enough permissions" indicating the user does not have sufficient permissions to read the item.

omissions.description: Reading an item by a second, non-owner user is not denied; GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} returns the item without checking ownership or permissions, instead of responding with status 400 and detail "Not enough permissions".
omissions.reasoning: The requirement is about access control for reading another user's item. In read_item, the code only checks whether the item exists and then returns it. Unlike update_item and delete_item, there is no guard such as `if not current_user.is_superuser and item.owner_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Not enough permissions")`.
